text: Two girls fooled the creator of Sherlock Holmes. In nineteen seventeen, they took photos of fairies. Arthur Conan Doyle, the creator of Sherlock Holmes, believed them. He wrote that the fairies were real. For sixty six years, the girls kept quiet. Then they admitted it. The fairies were paper cut outs on hatpins. But to the end, they said they really had seen fairies. Would you have believed the photos?
